message.content:
Based on the provided image of the **Zainara Cosmetics** flyer, here is an exhaustive analysis for website reconstruction and brand matching:

### 1. Brand Name & Spelling
*   **English:** ZAINARA COSMETICS
*   **Arabic:** None present (The text is in German).

### 2. Logo Description
*   **Monogram:** A stylized, interlocking "ZC" in a metallic gold gradient. The "Z" is large and dominant, with the "C" wrapping around its lower right side.
*   **Typography:** The word **ZAINARA** is set in an elegant, all-caps serif font (resembling a modern Didot or Bodoni style). **COSMETICS** is placed directly below in a smaller, spaced-out sans-serif font, creating a high-contrast luxury look.

### 3. Color Palette
*   **Primary Gold (Logo/Headings):** A rich, metallic antique gold. *Approx Hex: #D4AF37 or #C5A059*
*   **Deep Forest Green (Borders/Accents):** Used for the rounded rectangle frame around the eye image and section dividers. *Approx Hex: #2F4F3F or #3D5A47*
*   **Cream/Off-White (Background):** A warm, soft ivory background that feels organic and clean. *Approx Hex: #FDFBF7 or #F5F2E9*
*   **Text Black:** A soft charcoal black for readability that isn't harsh. *Approx Hex: #333333*
*   **Dark Teal/Grey (Contact Bar):** The background color behind the phone number. *Approx Hex: #2C3E35*

### 4. Typography
*   **Headings (e.g., WEITERE BEHANDLUNGEN):** Bold, all-caps Sans-Serif (likely a geometric or humanist sans like Montserrat or Futura) in the Primary Gold color.
*   **Body Text (Services):** Clean, legible Sans-Serif (similar to Open Sans or Lato), regular weight, dark grey/black.
*   **Brand Name:** High-contrast Serif (Luxury/Editorial style).
*   **Contact Info:** White Sans-Serif on the dark background bar.

### 5. Services & Pricing (Transcribed Exactly)

**Section 1: WEITERE BEHANDLUNGEN (Further Treatments)**
*   BioRePeel — **80 €**
*   BB Glow — **70 €**
*   Green Peel Classic inkl. — **299 €**
*   Nachbehandlung — *(No price listed)*
*   Green Peel Energy — **130 €**
*   Kristallpeeling — **60 €**
*   Zahnbleaching — 30 min **60 €** | 60 min **99 €**

**Section 2: PERMANENT MAKE-UP**
*   Microblading inkl. Nachbehandlung — **250 €**
    *   *Sub-note:* Haltbarkeit: bis zu 2 Jahre
*   Powder Brows inkl. Nachbehandlung — **250 €**
    *   *Sub-note:* Haltbarkeit: bis zu 2 Jahre
*   Augenbrauenlifting inkl. Färben — **45 €**
    *   *Sub-note:* Haltbarkeit: bis zu 4 Wochen
*   Wimpernlifting inkl. Färben — **45 €**
    *   *Sub-note:* Haltbarkeit: bis zu 4 Wochen
*   Augenbrauen zupfen — **15 €**
*   Augenbrauen zupfen und färben — **28 €**
*   Gesichtshaarentfernung mit Fadentechnik — **40 €**

### 6. Contact Information
*   **Address:** Darmstädter Str. 50, 64380 Roßdorf (Germany)
*   **Phone:** 01577 3435692
*   **Instagram:** @zainara-cosmetic
*   **QR Code:** Present (presumably links to booking or Instagram).
*   **Website URL:** Not explicitly listed as a URL, but implied via the QR code and social handle.

### 7. Tagline / Slogan
*   **Primary:** Laser & Beauty-Hair Removal
*   **Secondary (Service List):** Gesichtsbehandlungen - Permanent Make-up - Körperbehandlungen
*(Translation: Facial Treatments - Permanent Make-up - Body Treatments)*

### 8. Design Style
*   **Luxury Minimalism / "Clean Girl" Aesthetic.** It balances medical professionalism (laser/hair removal) with high-end spa elegance (cosmetics). It uses plenty of white space (or cream space) to convey premium pricing and exclusivity.

### 9. Decorative Elements
*   **Botanical Motifs:** Faint, watermark-style leaf illustrations (eucalyptus or olive branches) in the top right corner and bottom left, suggesting natural/organic ingredients.
*   **Rounded Geometry:** The central image of the eyes is enclosed in a "squircle" (rounded square) with a thick dark green border.
*   **Curved Lines:** Thin, elegant curved lines separate the service sections, softening the layout.
*   **Iconography:** Standard map pin icon for address, phone icon for contact, and Instagram camera icon.

### 10. Mood, Audience & Positioning
*   **Mood:** Serene, professional, trustworthy, feminine, and sophisticated.
*   **Target Audience:** Women (primarily aged 25-50+) in the Roßdorf/Darmstadt area interested in semi-permanent beauty solutions, anti-aging skincare, and laser hair removal. Clients who value quality over budget options.
*   **Positioning:** A premium "one-stop-shop" for cosmetic enhancement, bridging the gap between a medical clinic and a day spa.

### 12. Layout Structure for Web
*   **Grid System:** Asymmetrical 2-column layout (approx. 45% left / 55% right).
*   **Left Column:** Vertical stack of information. 
    *   *Top:* Bullet-point list of "Further Treatments."
    *   *Middle:* Hero visual (the "Before/After" eye graphic) acting as a visual break.
    *   *Bottom:* Detailed "Permanent Make-up" menu with sub-descriptions for longevity.
*   **Right Column:** Branding and Contact focus.
    *   *Top:* Centered Logo + Brand Name.
    *   *Middle:* Centered Tagline/Service categories.
    *   *Lower Middle:* Contact block (Address, Phone, Social) styled as a dark card/bar with white text and icons. QR code floated to the right of this block.
    *   *Bottom:* Large, high-quality lifestyle photography (the model) that bleeds to the edge, grounding the page with a human element.
*   **Background:** Full-page subtle texture or faint botanical watermark.
